agents.lockedRecruiter: Only a company admin can upload the verification papers, from the company page.

agents.emptyDirectory: No consultants in the directory yet.

dashboard.nextVerificationBody: The review sent them back. Upload them again to get verified.

dashboard.nextProfileBody: Companies search the consultant directory. A complete profile shows them your experience clearly.
dashboard.savedClosedLede: These listings have expired or been closed by the company. They stay here until you remove them.
dashboard.profilePreview: See your profile as companies see it
dashboard.profileViews: {count, plural, one {<v>#</v> company has} other {<v>#</v> companies have}} opened your profile in the last 30 days.
dashboard.profileRestricted: An admin has restricted your profile, so it is hidden from the directory and from employers until the restriction is lifted. You can still edit it. Contact support with any questions.

apply.title: Apply for {job}
apply.subtitle: Under a minute. No cover letter.
apply.cvOptional: Optional — PDF or Word, up to 10 MB
apply.successBody: The employer will reach you on WhatsApp at the number you gave. You will find the application under “My applications”, and we will tell you the moment it moves.
apply.alreadyApplied: You have already applied to this job.
apply.employerCannotApply: You're signed in as a company. Applying is for consultants only.
apply.rateLimit: You have applied to a lot of jobs today. Try again tomorrow.
apply.privacyBody: Only the company that posted this role sees your name and photo, WhatsApp number, years of experience, and your CV and note if you attach them. Other companies and site visitors do not see your application.
apply.privacyProfile: The name and number you enter here also update your account.
apply.privacyNote: If your consultant directory profile is not hidden, this company also sees it in full — headline, tracks, districts and your sales record — and can ask for your number and CV from it, even if it is not verified. You can withdraw the application at any time from “My applications”.
apply.suspendedBody: You cannot apply to roles until an administrator has reviewed your account.

employer.noJobs: You have not posted a job yet.
employer.createCompanyFirstBody: We need your company details before your first job post.
employer.verificationBody: Upload your commercial register and tax card. Verification removes the one-live-listing limit and opens full profiles in the consultant directory.
employer.unverifiedCap: Unverified companies may keep only one active job post.
employer.listingMoved: This listing changed somewhere else while you were editing. Reload the page and try again.
employer.companyMoved: Someone else at the company saved this profile while you had it open. Reload to see their version before saving.
employer.freePostClaimed: This month's free post has been claimed.
employer.freePostRefused: We could not grant the free post. Verification has to be complete, and it is once a calendar month.
employer.postCapBlocked: You already have an active listing. Unverified companies may keep only one.
employer.decisionNoteHint: The applicant sees this. One clear line beats silence.
employer.decisionNotePlaceholder: e.g. Less experience than this role needs — we have kept your profile for future openings.
employer.notesHint: The applicant cannot see any of this. For your team only.
employer.notesPlaceholder: For example: called today, will get back on Thursday.
employer.pendingBody: We check company details before the first listing goes out. Complete your company profile and upload your commercial registry to move it along.
employer.allApplicantsLede: Everyone who applied to your listings, newest first.
employer.applicantsSuspendedTitle: Applicants are hidden while your company is suspended
employer.applicantsSuspendedBody: The applications you received are kept, and the applicants’ names, numbers and CVs come back when the suspension is lifted. The notice on your dashboard says why and how to ask for a review.
employer.logoHint: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 2 MB. Shown beside your company name everywhere.
employer.jobsLede: All your listings and where each one stands.
employer.companyLede: Your company as candidates see it.
employer.newJobLede: Fill in the details and the listing goes for review.
employer.editJobLede: Any change sends the listing back for review before it shows again.
employer.teamBody: Add colleagues so they can see applicants and post listings under the company.
employer.teamRoleAdminHint: Can edit the company profile and add or remove colleagues.
employer.teamRoleRecruiterHint: Can post listings and work the applicants.
employer.teamOnlyAdmins: Only company admins can change the team.
employer.teamNoAccount: No company account with that email. Ask them to sign up as a company, then add them here.
employer.teamAlreadyMember: They are already on the team.
employer.teamRateLimited: Too many additions in a short time. Try again in an hour.
employer.teamCannotRemoveOwner: The account owner cannot be removed from their own company.
employer.setupLede: Finish these to start receiving applicants.
employer.setupCompanyHint: A description and a logo — what a consultant sees beside every listing.
employer.setupVerificationHint: Upload your documents. Verified companies also see full profiles in the consultant directory.
employer.setupVerificationRedo: The documents need another look — upload them again.
employer.setupFirstJobHint: Write the role; it goes for review before it is published.
employer.setupFirstJobPending: Your listing is in review — we will tell you the moment it is live.
employer.setupFirstJobDraft: You have a saved draft — finish it and send it for review.
employer.noApplicantsHint: Nobody has applied to this listing yet. Read the advert the way a consultant reads it, or check your other listings.
employer.applicantsPrivacy: These numbers and CVs reached you because their owners applied to your listings. Use them for this role only, and do not share them outside your company.
employer.applicantProfilePrivate: This consultant keeps their directory profile private. What they sent you above — name, number and CV — is everything they agreed to show.
employer.applicantMovedAlready: Someone else at the company moved this applicant first. We have refreshed to their latest status.
employer.duplicateTitle: You already have a listing with this title in this area
employer.duplicateBody: “{title}” has {seats, plural, one {# open seat} other {# open seats}}. If this is the same role, add seats to it instead of posting again — a duplicate splits your applicants.
employer.shortlistLede: People worth remembering, kept for the whole company — not tied to one listing.
employer.shortlistEmptyHint: From the consultant directory, or any consultant’s page, press “Add to shortlist”.
employer.shortlistGoneHint: They chose to hide their profile, so we cannot show their details. You can remove them from the list.
employer.reopenHint: It goes back for review first; the 30 days start again once it is published.
employer.applicantsCapped: Showing the newest <v>{count}</v> applicants only. Narrow with the filters or the search to reach the rest.
employer.teamElsewhere: That account already belongs to another company’s team. An account belongs to one company.
employer.duplicateListingBlocked: You already have this listing in this district more than once. Add seats to the existing one instead of posting it again.
employer.postRateLimited: This company has created a lot of listings today. Try again tomorrow.
employer.standingBlocked: Your account is restricted or suspended, so nothing can be sent for review right now. The notice on your dashboard says why and how to ask for a review.
employer.companySuspendedBlocked: Your company is suspended, so its listings can’t be submitted or published. The notice on your dashboard says why and how to ask for a review.

jobForm.titleEnHint: Optional — used on the English version of the page.
jobForm.seatsHint: This is the first number the market reads. Be honest about it.
jobForm.salaryHint: Leave empty if the role is commission only.
jobForm.commissionNoteHint: When it is paid, and what it is calculated on.
jobForm.leadsSourceHint: The single line consultants care most about.
jobForm.developersHint: Which developers this hire will be selling.
jobForm.reviewNote: We review listings before they go live, and we will tell you when it is published or if it needs changes.
jobForm.liveEditNote: This listing is live. Changing any of its text — title, description, requirements, commission note — or its salary, commission, employment type, seats or leads sends it back for review before it shows again. Anything else saves straight away.
jobForm.descriptionRules: Listings that ask candidates for money, or for ID or bank details before an interview, are taken down.

admin.title: Admin
admin.jobsQueueLede: Every listing by stage — the review queue first, oldest first.
admin.companiesQueueLede: Every company — the verification queue first, oldest first.
admin.reportsLede: One case per listing, company or consultant reported. Most serious allegation first, then the most people, then the longest wait.
admin.usersLede: Find any account, inspect it, and approve, suspend or restore it.
admin.suspendTakesListingsDown: Suspending also takes down the company's live listings, unless an approved colleague remains.
admin.emailActivityLede: Every message the platform sent, and what became of it.
admin.emailPreviewHint: Every template can be previewed at
admin.emailOffOutbox: Nothing is being recorded at all — the service key is missing, so a message fails before it is ever written. Set these in Vercel and redeploy.
admin.emailOffSending: Messages are recorded but never sent — the Resend credentials are missing. Set these in Vercel and redeploy.
admin.mailOffBody: Every email — application receipts, new applicants, digests — is being dropped silently. These variables are missing in Vercel:
admin.operationsLede: Scheduled tasks, the email retry queue, and the messages the system stopped trying to send.
admin.opsDeadLede: Messages that failed every attempt or ran out of time. Retry gives one more attempt on the next sweep.
admin.securityLede: What the platform noticed in the last 24 hours, and who decided what.
admin.secLimitsHint: These apply inside the database itself. Change one with a SQL statement on the abuse_limits table, with the reason written beside it.
admin.overviewLede: What is waiting on a decision, and how the marketplace looks today.
admin.searchEverythingPlaceholder: Name, email, phone, listing title or ID…
admin.trailEmpty: No decisions or notes recorded yet.
admin.contactRecorded: Your viewing of these details and the reason were recorded.
admin.revealContactBody: Contact details never appear in lists. Say why you need them — the reason is recorded with your name.
admin.notePlaceholder: What the investigation found — admins only…
admin.noteInternal: Internal: cannot be edited or deleted, and only admins can read it.
admin.searchLede: Find any account, company, listing or application.
admin.searchNothing: Nothing found. Try part of a name, a full email, or an ID.
admin.usersSearchPlaceholder: Name, full email, phone number or account ID…
admin.adminNoLever: Admin accounts cannot be suspended from here.
admin.approveAccountBody: The account will be able to act, and its owner is emailed.
admin.suspendCandidateBody: The account will not be able to apply or report, and its owner is told the reason.
admin.reportsFiledSummary: {count} filed, {dismissed} found to be no violation.
admin.reporterPattern: Most of their reports found no violation — weigh that.
admin.companiesSearchPlaceholder: Company name in Arabic or English, or slug…
admin.verifyCompanyBody: Pending papers are marked reviewed, the company gets the verified badge, and it is emailed.
admin.verifyWithoutPapers: The company has no pending papers. Verify only if you confirmed another way — and say how.
admin.requestChangesCompanyBody: The papers go back to the company with your note so it can upload corrected copies.
admin.rejectVerificationBody: The company stays unverified and capped at one live listing, and is told why.
admin.revokeVerificationBody: The badge is removed and the one-listing cap applies to new approvals. Live listings are not affected.
admin.suspendCompanyHint: For a company that is itself the problem — not one bad recruiter.
admin.restoreCompanyHint: Lifting a suspension brings no listings back; restore each one from its own page.
admin.suspendCompanyBody: Every live and waiting listing comes down at once, and it cannot submit new ones until the suspension is lifted. The reason is sent to the company's members; candidates who applied see only that the company is suspended.
admin.restoreCompanyBody: The company will be able to submit listings for review again.
admin.quietHint: Live for more than three days with no applicants — often a sign the listing needs work.
admin.approveListingBody: It goes live for 30 days and the company is emailed. The unverified-company cap and credits apply.
admin.requestChangesListingBody: The listing goes back to the company with your note; it can edit and resubmit.
admin.rejectListingBody: It will not be published, and the company is told why.
admin.unpublishBody: It leaves the board immediately and the company is told why. Existing applications stay with the company.
admin.closeListingBody: On the company's behalf — for example when it asked support. The company can repost it itself later.
admin.restoreListingBody: It goes live again. If its window has run out a new 30 days starts, spending a credit when credits are required. The one-listing cap applies.
admin.featureBody: Pinned to the top of the board for 14 days, marked Sponsored.
admin.draftNoLever: A company draft — nothing to moderate until the company submits it.
admin.closedNoLever: Closed by the company. Reposting is its decision.
admin.investigateBody: The reports are marked as under investigation so other admins know someone has them.
admin.resolveTakeDownJobBody: The listing leaves the board and the company is told why; every report closes in the same step.
admin.resolveSuspendCompanyBody: All the company's live and waiting listings come down, and the reports close in the same step.
admin.resolveRestrictAgentBody: The profile leaves the directory and every employer's view until lifted, and the reports close.
admin.resolveOnlyBody: For example when the owner already fixed it. Nothing is taken down.
admin.dismissBody: The reports close as no violation. This counts towards each reporter's record.
admin.applicationsLede: For investigating only: what happened to an application, who moved it and when. Nothing is changed from here.
admin.filteredToOne: Showing one listing's or one candidate's applications.
admin.applicationReadOnly: This page is read-only. Moving an application is the employer's decision; withdrawing it is the candidate's.
admin.agentsLede: Every consultant profile, visible or hidden. Contact details live on the account page only.
admin.liftRestrictionBody: The profile stays hidden until the consultant chooses to be seen again — that choice is theirs.
admin.restrictProfileBody: The profile leaves the directory and every employer's view, and the consultant cannot make it visible until lifted. Their account and applications are unaffected.
admin.contactOnAccount: Contact details are on the account page, behind a reason.
admin.auditLede: Every admin decision — who, when and why. This record cannot be edited or deleted.
admin.taxonomyLede: Districts, governorates and developers. Renames show on the site at once; only unused entries can be deleted.
admin.fixedListsHint: These lists are fixed in the code and the database — the posting form, filters, landing pages and search are built on them. Changing one needs a release, not a button here, so listings filed under a value are never orphaned.
admin.slugPermanent: The slug cannot change once added.
admin.deleteEntryBody: Nothing uses it. Deleting is permanent.

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.not_found: Not found — someone may have handled or removed it already.
errors.no_change: That is already the case. The page has been refreshed.
errors.invalid_transition: The state has changed and this action no longer applies. The page now shows the current state.
errors.stale_version: This changed after you opened the page. The page now shows it as it is — read it again before deciding.
errors.reason_required: Give a reason (at least three characters).
errors.post_cap: This company is unverified and already has a live listing. Verify it first or close the current one.
errors.no_credits: This company has no post credits left, and publishing spends one.
errors.company_suspended: The company is suspended; its listings cannot be submitted or published.
errors.taxonomy_in_use: It is in use by listings or profiles, and deleting it would break them. Rename it instead.
errors.taxonomy_slug_is_permanent: The slug is part of public URLs and cannot change.
errors.invalid_slug: Slug: lowercase latin letters, digits and single hyphens.
errors.invalid_name: Both names are required, up to 80 characters.
errors.unavailable: The file is not available right now.
errors.not_migrated: The database needs migrations 316–319, 325–328 and 346 before this action works.
errors.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. Nothing was changed.
errors.network: The connection dropped before we could confirm. The page has been refreshed — check the state before retrying.

admin.filterRepeat: Reported by more than one person
admin.severityHint: From the reason the reporter chose: what was alleged, not a verdict.
admin.noisyReporters: With a record of groundless or bad-faith reports: {count}
admin.systemFlag: Raised by the platform from the company’s own text
admin.snapshotLabel: What it said when it was reported
admin.dismissAbusiveBody: This one report closes as filed in bad faith. It goes on the reporter’s record, which the next moderator sees. It restricts nobody by itself — that is a separate decision, on the reporter’s account page.
admin.abusiveReasonLabel: Why (kept on the record, sent to nobody)
admin.closeDeletedBody: What was reported has been deleted, so these reports can only be closed. Each keeps what the listing or profile said when it was reported.
admin.flagsNone: Nothing in its own words stands out.

flag.asks_for_money: Mentions a payment asked of the candidate
flag.asks_for_documents: Asks for ID, bank or login details
flag.form_link: A link to an outside form
flag.suspicious_link: A link to a bare address or a look-alike domain
flag.phone_in_text: A phone number in the text
flag.email_in_text: An email address in the text

signal.mass_posting: Many listings at once: {day} in the last day, {week} in the last week
signal.rejections: Listings rejected or taken down in the last 90 days: {count}
signal.duplicate_listings: The same advert, live or waiting, this many times: {count}
signal.copied_listings: An advert word for word the same as one from
signal.reported: Reported by different people in the last 90 days: {reporters} ({reports} reports)
signal.flagged_listings: Live or waiting listings with a high-weight flag: {count}
signal.shared_phone: A member’s WhatsApp number is also used at
signal.phone_of_suspended_account: A member’s WhatsApp number also belongs to a suspended account: {count}

admin.appealsLede: Somebody says a decision about them was wrong. Oldest first — they have been waiting longest.
admin.appealUpholdBody: The decision stays. Your reason is sent to the person who appealed, so write it for them.
admin.appealNoteToPerson: Note to the person (sent to them)

appealOverturnBody.job: The listing goes back on the board, through the same rules as any approval — the post cap and credits still apply.
appealOverturnBody.company: The suspension is lifted. Its listings do not come back by themselves; restore the ones that deserve it one by one.
appealOverturnBody.agent: The restriction is lifted. The profile stays hidden until the consultant chooses who can see it.

admin.restrictAccountBodyEmployer: A hold, not a suspension: their live listings stay up, but until you lift it they can’t post, edit or close listings, or send anything for review. They are told, with your reason, and can ask for a review.
admin.restrictAccountBodyCandidate: A hold, not a suspension: their applications stay, but they cannot apply to new jobs until you lift it. They are told, with your reason, and can ask for a review.
admin.reportingBanBody: They can no longer file reports; everything else about the account is unchanged. When they try, they are told reporting is unavailable on their account — not why.
admin.reportingUnbanBody: They can file reports again, under the same limits as everyone.
admin.reportingBanReason: Why (kept on the record, sent to nobody)
admin.deletionRequestsLede: Company owners asking to leave. Deleting the account would delete the company, its listings and the applications to them: agree what happens to the company, do it, then close the request.

hero.eyebrow: The specialist job market for Egyptian real estate
hero.title: A job board made for real estate in Egypt
hero.subtitle: We ask every company for the basic salary and the commission in figures, and who supplies the leads — not "attractive package" and "generous commission".

features.title: Why this board
features.payBody: The basic salary, the commission and the lead source sit in a structured card at the top of the listing, not buried in the description.
features.leadsBody: Every listing says whether the company provides leads or the consultant generates their own. It is the line consultants care most about, and you can filter on it.
features.seatsBody: One opening or twenty-five? The number is on the card before you open it, so you know what kind of role it is at a glance.
features.freshBody: Every listing closes automatically 30 days after it goes live, so you won't find posts from months ago.
features.applyBody: Name, WhatsApp number, experience band. The CV is optional and there is no cover letter.
features.whatsappBody: If a company is interested, it can reach you directly on WhatsApp — nothing lost to a spam folder.

how.title: How it works
how.candidate1Body: Track, district, experience — and the one that counts: basic salary, or commission only.
how.candidate2Body: Your details are saved, so every application after the first is one tap.
how.candidate3Body: Track where each application stands from your dashboard.
how.employer1Body: Commercial register and tax card. Verification removes the one-live-listing limit and opens full profiles in the consultant directory.
how.employer2Body: The form asks for pay, commission and lead source, so applicants know the terms before they apply.
how.employer3Body: Every applicant in one pipeline, with a WhatsApp button and a pre-written opener.
how.candidate2Takeaway: You will not retype your details.
how.candidate3Takeaway: If the company is interested, it contacts you.

agentsBand.title: The consultant directory: you decide who sees you
agentsBand.body: Employed and not ready for your company to know you're looking? Keep your profile completely hidden. Or keep your name and contact details for verified companies only — unverified companies see a card without your name or photo.
agentsBand.point1: Visible to all companies, verified companies only, or entirely hidden
agentsBand.point2: The directory is for companies only — visitors and other job seekers can't see it
agentsBand.point3: You change it whenever you want

employerBand.title: Hiring real estate consultants?
employerBand.body: Put your role in front of people actually looking in the Egyptian market. Posting is completely free during launch.

employerHero.eyebrow: For real estate companies in Egypt
employerHero.title: Hire consultants who are actually looking
employerHero.subtitle: Post with the salary, the commission and the lead source spelled out, so whoever applies knows the terms from the start.

employerWhy.title: Why post here
employerWhy.subtitle: When the terms are clear from the start, applicants know what they are walking into.
employerWhy.clarityTitle: They know the terms before they apply
employerWhy.clarityBody: We ask for the salary, the commission and the lead source in every listing, so whoever applies has seen your terms first.
employerWhy.nicheBody: Not a general job site: every listing here is a property job.
employerWhy.pipelineBody: One list, a status per applicant, a WhatsApp button with the opener written, and CVs behind short-lived links.
employerWhy.verifiedBody: Upload your commercial register and tax card for a verified badge, no limit on live listings, and full profiles in the consultant directory.
employerWhy.seatsBody: One opening and twenty-five are different propositions. The number is on the card, and candidates can sort by it.
employerWhy.freshBody: Thirty days and it expires automatically, so nobody applies to a role you filled two months ago.

blog.title: Blog
blog.subtitle: Explainers and advice for working the Egyptian real estate market — for consultants and for companies.
blog.ctaBody: Every listing names who supplies the leads, with the salary and commission in figures whenever the company publishes them.

unsubscribe.doneBody: You can turn them back on any time from your account settings.
unsubscribe.invalidBody: It may be incomplete or out of date. You can change this from your account settings.
unsubscribe.failed: We could not turn those emails off just now.
unsubscribe.failedBody: Try again shortly, or change it from your account settings.

legal.missing: This document is not available right now
legal.updatedTitle: We have updated our Terms of use and Privacy policy

legal.agreeFailed: We could not record your agreement. Please try again.

account.title: Account settings
account.subtitle: What we email you, a copy of your data, and deleting your account.
account.emailsBody: Turn any of these off, and back on whenever you like.
account.notifyApplications: New applicant on one of your roles
account.notifyApplicationsHint: An email as soon as someone applies to a listing of yours.
account.notifyStatusHint: When a company moves your application, or your listing is reviewed.
account.notifyDigestHint: What's new from your saved searches and the companies you follow, once a week.
account.notifyProfileNudge: A reminder to finish your profile
account.notifyProfileNudgeHint: One email if your profile is left unfinished after you sign up. Off unless you turn it on.
account.exportBody: A file with your account, profile, applications, settings and more, in a format any tool can read, with links to your CV files that work for an hour.
account.deleteBody: This removes your account, profile, applications and uploaded files. It cannot be undone.
account.deleteBlockedCompany: Your account owns a company. Deleting it would remove the company, every listing it published, and every application other people sent you — that is their data too, not only yours. Contact us and we will handle it properly.
account.deleteUnavailable: We could not delete the account just now. Please try again later.
account.passwordBody: Change your password. You will stay signed in on this device.
account.emailBody: We send a confirmation to both the old and the new address. Nothing changes until you confirm.
account.emailPending: Confirmation sent. Open the new address and confirm from there.
account.oauthOnly: This account signs in with Google, so there is no password to change.
account.notifyApplicantDigest: One email a day instead of one per applicant
account.notifyApplicantDigestHint: For listings that attract a lot of people. The summary arrives in the morning and replaces the individual notice.
account.photoHint: Shown to employers with your application and on your directory profile. PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 2 MB.
account.suspendedBody: An administrator has suspended this account. You will not be able to use the platform until it is reviewed. If you think this is a mistake, get in touch.
account.mfaBody: A code from an authenticator app (such as Google Authenticator) is asked for alongside your password. Optional for any account, required for admin accounts.
account.mfaScan: Scan this code with your authenticator app, then enter the number it shows.
account.mfaQrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
account.mfaSecret: Or enter this key by hand
account.mfaEnabled: Two-step verification is on for your account.
account.mfaChallengeBody: Enter the code from your authenticator app to continue.
account.mfaRequiredBanner: Admin accounts must set up two-step verification before the admin console opens.
account.mfaChallengeBanner: Confirm with a code from your authenticator app so the admin console opens in this session.
account.mfaLost: Lost the phone with your authenticator app? Write to <link>{email}</link> and we will help you back into your account.
account.mfaCodeInvalid: That code is not right. Try the new number in the app.
account.deleteBlockedSuspended: Your account is suspended, so it can’t be deleted from here while the decision stands. You can ask for the suspension to be reviewed from your dashboard, or contact us and we’ll close the account once the case is done.
account.deleteRequested: We have your request (reference {reference}). We will write to you within 7 days to agree what happens to the company, and your account is deleted within 30 days.
account.deleteRequestLimited: You have sent several requests today, and we have them. There is no need to send another.

reportHint.scam: Asks you to pay, or for your ID, bank details or a code sent to your phone
reportHint.fake_listing: The job doesn’t exist, or isn’t what the advert says
reportHint.impersonation: Uses the name or logo of a company or person it isn’t
reportHint.misleading_pay: The pay, commission or conditions aren’t what was advertised
reportHint.spam: The same advert again and again, or not a real job
reportHint.other: Something else — say what in a line below
reportHint.suspicious_company: The company doesn’t seem to exist, or isn’t who it says it is

standing.suspendedBodyEmployer: You can sign in and see everything, but you can’t post listings or send them for review while it is suspended. Nothing has been deleted.
standing.suspendedBodyCandidate: You can sign in and see your applications, but you can’t apply or report while it is suspended. Nothing has been deleted.
standing.heldTitle: Your account is restricted while we review it
standing.heldBodyEmployer: Your live listings stay up. Until the review ends you can’t post, edit or close listings, or send anything for review.
standing.heldBodyCandidate: Your applications stay as they are. Until the review ends you can’t apply to new jobs.
standing.companySuspendedBody: Its listings are off the board, and nothing new can be submitted until the suspension is lifted. Applications you already received are kept, but their applicants are hidden until then.

appeals.label: Why is this a mistake?
appeals.hint: A sentence or two is enough: what we got wrong, and anything that shows it.
appeals.sent: Sent. We’ll tell you the answer here and in your notifications.
appeals.waiting: You asked for a review on {date}. We’ll tell you the answer here and in your notifications.
appeals.stands: We reviewed this on {date}, and the decision stands.
appeals.messageRequired: Say in at least a sentence why the decision was wrong.
appeals.notAppealable: There’s nothing here to appeal right now.
appeals.alreadyOpen: You’ve already asked for a review of this — we’ll answer that one first.
appeals.limit: This decision has been reviewed three times, so it can’t be appealed again. Contact us if something new has come up.
appeals.tooSoon: We answered an appeal about this in the last week. You can ask again once a week has passed.
appeals.rateLimit: You’ve sent several appeals today. Please try again tomorrow.
appeals.companySuspended: Your company is suspended, so ask for a review of the company’s suspension instead.
appeals.unavailable: Appeals aren’t available yet. Please contact us.
appeals.network: We couldn’t send it. Check your connection and try again.
